# ai-first-search

> Search-engine-backed multi-URL Markdown extraction API for LLM agents. Free OSS alternative to Tavily / Exa / Perplexity's search-and-read APIs.

Public instance: https://ai-first-search.onrender.com

## Endpoint
`GET /search?q=<query>&k=<1..10>&max_tokens=<int?>` → JSON

```
{
  "query": "...",
  "k": 5,
  "scraper_url": "https://ai-first-scraper.onrender.com",
  "results": [
    {"url": "...", "title": "...", "snippet": "...", "ok": true,
     "markdown": "...", "word_count": 1240},
    ...
  ]
}
```

## How an AI agent should use this
1. User asks a question.
2. `GET /search?q=<question>&k=5&max_tokens=1500`.
3. Iterate `results[]`. Use `title`+`snippet` to pick most relevant. Drop their `markdown` into your prompt.
4. Cite using `url`.

## Tool definition
```json
{
  "name": "search_web_as_markdown",
  "description": "Run a web search and return the top-N result pages already converted to clean Markdown.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "q": {"type": "string"},
      "k": {"type": "integer", "default": 5},
      "max_tokens": {"type": "integer"}
    },
    "required": ["q"]
  }
}
```
